brief.summary_1line: After Akampana’s death, Ravana orders Prahasta to lead a massive sortie from Lanka against Rama’s monkey army, and Prahasta marches out with ritual and fanfare.

image_candidates.scene_text: Prahasta stands in a golden chariot with a serpent-banner as drums thunder and ranks of armored titans surge out of Lanka’s eastern gate.
Inside the banner-filled city of Lanka, Ravana consults his ministers with a dark expression after hearing of Akampana’s death.
Rakshasa warriors in armor offer clarified butter into sacred fire while garlands and fragrant wind swirl before they march to war.
